verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS team inbox with no CLI or headless binary, but it documents its own public REST API (/v1 endpoints for conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and analytics, with explicit rate limits and 429 handling) plus an MCP server. That lets scripts or CI jobs drive the product programmatically without the UI, and drafts can be created through the API. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or examples, OpenAPI spec for tooling, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
